correctness.rationale: Constructed Q4 with 16 vertices and its 32 edges, exhaustive backtracking by the first unmatched vertex enumerating 272 perfect matchings, with no duplicates or omissions. Generated all 24 coordinate squares and their opposite-edge-pair flips; independently, a pair of matchings with four-edge symmetric difference is a square flip because symmetric difference is an alternating four-cycle. Enumerated 8 isolated vertices and one 264-vertex component. New independent BFS from every vertex of this component counted the exact all-pairs distances (768,2640,6032,9360,9504,5296,1104,12) summing to C(264,2), eccentricities 7:252 and 8:12, and 12 distance-eight pairs incident to 12 vertices. Read pinned verifier that separately checks two matchings enumerators, two adjacency constructors, 384 affine cube automorphisms and the antipodal graph with components [4,4,4]; its complete bounded loops establish three four-cycles. Finite exhaustive enumeration applies to exactly dimension 4.
risks: The diameter/radius are for the unique nontrivial component; distances across eight singleton components are undefined.
No claim for general Q_d; 264-root exhaustive finite proof is valid only for this state space.

value.rationale: The local flip graph is a standard finite testbed for higher-dimensional domino-tiling reconfiguration. Its complete geodesic histogram, sharp diameter, radius/eccentricity split and antipodal symmetry orbit are natural exact geometric invariants not determined by the known component count. A future researcher can use the precise 8-step obstruction to calibrate flip algorithms or conjectured dimension dependence; no all-d theorem is required for this motivated finite classification.
risks: Small finite case, not an asymptotic result; possible earlier unpublished enumeration.

final_claim: Among Q4 perfect matchings, eight are isolated and the unique other square-flip component has 264 vertices, radius 7 and diameter 8. Unordered distinct pair distances 1..8 have multiplicities (768,2640,6032,9360,9504,5296,1104,12); 252 vertices have eccentricity7 and 12 have eccentricity8; the distance-eight pairs form three disjoint four-cycles on one automorphism orbit.
limitations: Q4, elementary 4-cycle flips only; distances across disconnected components deliberately undefined.
